description_excerpt: MISSION The Product Application Engineer (PAE) is responsible for supporting the technical promotion, application, and business growth of Schneider Electric Power Systems products and solutions in Vietnam. The PAE serves as a product-focused technical expert, providing technical consultation, application support, and product positioning to internal sales teams, channel partners, contractors, consultants, and customers. The role requires a solid understanding of electrical power-system architecture, MV/LV distribution applications, relevant products, and customer engagement. The PAE works…
